facts.fact: Wingu.Africa officially launched its second carrier-neutral data centre in Djibouti, at the T07 Technology Park (3 MW design capacity), at a ceremony attended by President Guelleh.
The operator, Wingu.Africa, describes the newly launched T07 Technology Park data centre in Djibouti as a Tier 3 certified data centre; the certifying body is not named.
The article states Wingu.Africa's first carrier-neutral facility, the Djibouti Data Center, was launched in 2013.
